title: Simulation of a live body run
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be finite Boolean Turing machines, let $a$ be a state of $B$, choose Boolean forwarding, find, and startup modes, and let $p$ be a Boolean word. For a Boolean input word $x$, let $c$ be a configuration of the stopped-body machine extended with the counter and fuel tapes. Suppose that this extended body run has not halted at any time $u<t$. Then the loop host run for $t$ steps, started from the image of $c$ with the chosen modes and prefix, is the image of the extended body run at time $t$ with those same parameters.
hypotheses_covered: Forwarding, find, and startup parameters are Boolean
$c$ is a configuration of the extended stopped-body machine on $x$
For every $u<t$, the extended body run from $c$ has not halted
caveat: The image construction is private and its supplied informal description is only a stub, so its exact configuration contents cannot be rendered fully.
